items.title: Exclusive: Hung Vanngo Beauty is rethinking shade-matching with first foundation launch
items.summary: Forget warm, neutral and cool undertones — celebrity makeup artist-turned-brand founder Hung Vanngo is launching an inclusive foundation system with advanced shade-matching technology.

items.title: Physicians Formula returns to '2016 makeup' with a Jaclyn Hill and Manny MUA partnership
items.summary: To celebrate the Butter Bronzer's 10th anniversary and capture 2016-era nostalgia, Physicians Formula brings back KOL collaboration with Jaclyn Hill and Manny MUA.

items.title: Wellness Briefing: How brands are leveraging grassroots social wellness meetups
items.summary: Brands are leveraging grassroots social wellness meetups to build community and drive DTC growth in the beauty and wellness space.

items.title: Fashion Briefing: As Gen Z goes back to the mall, Garage is opening 20 profitable stores a year
items.summary: Gen Z is returning to physical retail, with brands like Garage opening new stores to capture that audience with in-store beauty and fashion experience.

items.title: Maura Higgins Makes a Case for the Return of the Rough-cut Pixie
items.summary: Celebrity beauty trend: the rough-cut pixie hairstyle is making a comeback, driven by influencer/celebrity visibility at Paris Couture Week.

items.title: Marketplace Briefing: AI traffic is poised to reshape the Amazon funnel
items.summary: AI referral traffic from ChatGPT and other AI tools is increasingly driving product discovery on Amazon, reshaping beauty brand marketing strategies.

items.title: How Dollar Shave Club decides when to use AI-generated creative
items.summary: Dollar Shave Club uses AI-generated ad creative for grooming/personal care DTC campaigns on social platforms, signaling a shift in beauty/personal care marketing.

items.title: Amazon Beauty Best Sellers: CeraVe, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Neutrogena dominate North America skincare rankings
items.summary: Amazon NA beauty bestsellers: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream, e.l.f. Power Grip Primer, and Neutrogena Hydro Boost continue to dominate. Drugstore/mass skincare with dermatologist credentials leads. Korean beauty (COSRX, Some By Mi) trending strongly. SPF products surge with summer season.

items.title: Sephora & Ulta 2026 North America: Skincare Hydration and Clean Beauty drive Q2 sales
items.summary: Sephora and Ulta North America sales trends show strong momentum in: (1) peptide/retinol anti-aging serums ($30-$80 range), (2) barrier repair moisturizers with ceramides, (3) SPF tinted moisturizers/BB creams for summer. Clean/natural beauty continues double-digit growth. Hero ingredients: hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, tranexamic acid for even skin tone.

items.title: TikTok Shop beauty virality: 'Skincare girl' routines and SPF-first messaging fuel NA Gen Z demand
items.summary: TikTok Shop NA beauty: viral product categories include SPF moisturizers, snail mucin serums, pimple patches, and multi-step Korean skincare. 'Skincare minimalism' (3-step routines) gaining traction vs complex 10-step. Affordable luxury ($15-$40) is the sweet spot. GRWM (Get Ready With Me) videos drive discovery and impulse purchase.
